IPProtocol.description:
The IP protocol to which this rule applies. The protocol type is
required when creating a firewall rule. This value can either be one of the
following well known protocol strings (tcp, udp,icmp, esp, ah, ipip,sctp) or the IP protocol number.

ports.description:
An optional list of ports to which this rule applies.
This field is only applicable for the UDP or TCP protocol.
Each entry must be either an integer or a range.
If not specified, this rule applies to connections through any port.

Example inputs include: ["22"], ["80","443"],
and ["12345-12349"].

IPProtocol.description:
The IP protocol to which this rule applies. The protocol type is
required when creating a firewall rule. This value can either be one of the
following well known protocol strings (tcp, udp,icmp, esp, ah, ipip,sctp) or the IP protocol number.

ports.description:
An optional list of ports to which this rule applies.
This field is only applicable for the UDP or TCP protocol.
Each entry must be either an integer or a range.
If not specified, this rule applies to connections through any port.

Example inputs include: ["22"], ["80","443"],
and ["12345-12349"].

ports.description:

This field is only applicable for the UDP or TCP protocol.
Each entry must be either an integer or a range.
If not specified, this rule applies to connections through any port.

Example inputs include: ["22"], ["80","443"],
and ["12345-12349"].

IPProtocol.description:
The IP protocol to which this rule applies. The protocol type is
required when creating a firewall rule. This value can either be one of the
following well known protocol strings (tcp, udp,icmp, esp, ah, ipip,sctp) or the IP protocol number.

ports.description:
An optional list of ports to which this rule applies.
This field is only applicable for the UDP or TCP protocol.
Each entry must be either an integer or a range.
If not specified, this rule applies to connections through any port.

Example inputs include: ["22"], ["80","443"],
and ["12345-12349"].

IPProtocol.description:
The IP protocol to which this rule applies. The protocol type is
required when creating a firewall rule. This value can either be one of the
following well known protocol strings (tcp, udp,icmp, esp, ah, ipip,sctp) or the IP protocol number.

ports.description:
An optional list of ports to which this rule applies.
This field is only applicable for the UDP or TCP protocol.
Each entry must be either an integer or a range.
If not specified, this rule applies to connections through any port.

Example inputs include: ["22"], ["80","443"],
and ["12345-12349"].

IPProtocol.description:
The IP protocol to which this rule applies. The protocol type is
required when creating a firewall rule. This value can either be one of the
following well known protocol strings (tcp, udp,icmp, esp, ah, ipip,sctp) or the IP protocol number.

ports.description:
An optional list of ports to which this rule applies.
This field is only applicable for the UDP or TCP protocol.
Each entry must be either an integer or a range.
If not specified, this rule applies to connections through any port.

Example inputs include: ["22"], ["80","443"],
and ["12345-12349"].

and ["12345-12349"].

def events():
            start, end = _audit_window(collector, scope)
            log = scope + '/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity'
            body = {'resourceNames': [scope], 'filter': f'logName="{log}" AND timestamp>="{start.isoformat()}" AND timestamp<="{end.isoformat()}"',
                    'orderBy': 'timestamp desc', 'pageSize': min(collector.page_size, 1000)}
            types = collector.options.get('asset_types')
            if (isinstance(types, list) and types and all(isinstance(t, str) and
                    re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9.-]+\.googleapis\.com/[A-Za-z0-9]+', t) for t in types)):
                # The CAI snapshots use this exact type selection. Unrelated
                # service logs cannot establish a change to those assets.
                services = sorted({('cloudsql.googleapis.com' if t.startswith('sqladmin.googleapis.com/')
                                    else t.split('/')[0]) for t in types})
                body['filter'] += ' AND (' + ' OR '.join('protoPayload.serviceName="' + s + '"' for s in services) + ')'
            seen = {}
            def project(row):
                payload, insert = row.get('protoPayload'), row.get('insertId')
                if (row.get('logName') != log or not isinstance(insert, str) or not insert or len(insert) > 1024 or
                        not isinstance(payload, dict) or payload.get('@type') != 'type.googleapis.com/google.cloud.audit.AuditLog'):
                    raise ReadError('malformed', 'asset_audit_native_type_or_identity_unresolved')
                service, resource, method = (payload.get(k) for k in ('serviceName', 'resourceName', 'methodName'))
                if (not isinstance(service, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9.-]+\.googleapis\.com', service) or
                        not isinstance(resource, str) or not resource or not isinstance(method, str) or not method):
                    raise ReadError('unavailable', 'asset_audit_resource_join_unresolved')
                if resource.startswith('//'):
                    if not resource.startswith('//' + service + '/'):
                        raise ReadError('malformed', 'asset_audit_resource_service_mismatch')
                    full_name = resource
                elif service == 'storage.googleapis.com' and resource.startswith('projects/_/buckets/'):
                    full_name = '//' + service + '/' + resource[len('projects/_/buckets/'):]
                else:
                    full_name = '//' + service + '/' + resource
                at = datetime.fromisoformat(_timestamp(row.get('timestamp')).replace('Z', '+00:00'))
                if not start <= at <= end:
                    raise ReadError('malformed', 'asset_audit_event_outside_window')
                status = payload.get('status', {})
                if not isinstance(status, dict) or type(status.get('code', 0)) is not int:
                    raise ReadError('malformed', 'asset_audit_operation_status_unresolved')
                operation = row.get('operation')
                if operation is not None and (not isinstance(operation, dict) or
                        any(type(operation[k]) is not bool for k in ('first', 'last') if k in operation)):
                    raise ReadError('malformed', 'asset_audit_operation_completion_unresolved')
                succeeded = status.get('code', 0) == 0 and (operation is None or operation.get('last') is True)
                result = {'name': log + '/entries/' + quote(insert, safe=''), 'logName': log,
                          'timestamp': row['timestamp'], 'operationSucceeded': succeeded,
                          'protoPayload': {'serviceName': service, 'resourceName': full_name, 'methodName': method}}
                if result['name'] in seen and seen[result['name']] != result:
                    raise ReadError('malformed', 'asset_audit_event_identity_conflict')
                seen[result['name']] = result
                return result
            yield from collector.pages('https://logging.googleapis.com/v2/entries:list', scope,
                key='entries', method='POST', page_size_key=None, body=body, transform=project)

def os_inventories(scope=scope):
                parent = complete_parent(collector, 'instance', scope)
                seen, failures = set(), []
                for vm in parent['items']:
                    instance = vm.get('name')
                    zone = vm.get('zone') or vm.get('_aggregated_scope')
                    zone = zone.rsplit('/', 1)[-1] if isinstance(zone, str) else None
                    if (not isinstance(instance, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}', instance)
                            or not isinstance(zone, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9-]+', zone)
                            or instance in seen):
                        raise ReadError('malformed', 'os_inventory_vm_join_unresolved')
                    seen.add(instance)
                    instance_id = str(vm.get('id') or instance)
                    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9-]+', instance_id):
                        raise ReadError('malformed', 'os_inventory_vm_id_unresolved')
                    expected = f'{scope}/locations/{zone}/instances/{instance_id}/inventory'
                    try:
                        yield from collector.pages(f'https://osconfig.googleapis.com/v1/{expected}', scope,
                            single=True, params={'view': 'FULL'},
                            transform=lambda row, instance=instance, expected=expected:
                                normalize_os_inventory(row, scope, instance, expected))
                    except ReadError as exc:
                        if getattr(exc, 'request_id', None):
                            yield [], exc.request_id
                        failures.append(exc)
                if failures:
                    raise failures[0]

def inventory(scope=scope):
            policy = collector.options.get('sw51_policy')
            types = policy.get('approved_asset_types') if isinstance(policy, dict) else None
            if (not isinstance(policy, dict) or policy.get('status') != 'collected' or policy.get('scope') != scope or
                    not isinstance(types, list) or not types or len(types) > 256 or
                    any(not isinstance(t, str) or not t for t in types) or len(set(types)) != len(types)):
                raise ReadError('unavailable', 'service_asset_approved_scope_unresolved')
            if set(types) - ASSET_INVENTORIES.keys():
                raise ReadError('unsupported', 'service_asset_approved_type_unsupported')
            seen = set()
            for asset_type in sorted(types):
                kind = ASSET_INVENTORIES[asset_type]
                parent = complete_parent(collector, kind, scope)
                for request_id in parent['source_requests']:
                    yield [], request_id
                for row in parent['items']:
                    name = _asset_name(row, asset_type, scope)
                    if name in seen:
                        raise ReadError('malformed', 'service_asset_identity_conflict')
                    seen.add(name)
                    requests = row.get('_provenance', {}).get('source_requests', [])
                    if not requests:
                        raise ReadError('malformed', 'service_asset_source_missing')
                    yield [{'name': name, 'assetType': asset_type, 'sourceInventory': kind,
                            'sourceNativeName': row.get('name')}], requests[0]

def finish(self):
        from peaso.snapshot import make_snapshot
        envelopes, hierarchy_discovery = [], []
        for key, collection in sorted(self.collections.items()):
            if key[1] == "discovery":
                # Search results only resolve scopes; each project/folder/org is
                # inventoried and evaluated once, in its own scope.
                hierarchy_discovery.append({"type": key[0], "status": collection.get("status"),
                    "coverage_status": collection.get("coverage_status"), "resource_count": len(collection["items"]),
                    "error": collection.get("error"), "source_requests": collection.get("source_requests", [])})
                continue
            if (key[0] in self.wanted or key[0] == "project" and
                    (self.options.get("all_projects") or key[1] in getattr(self, "proven_project_alias_scopes", set())
                     or key[1] in getattr(self, "proven_api_key_alias_scopes", set()))):
                collection["items"].sort(key=lambda item: item["_resource_id"])
                envelopes.append(collection)
        metadata = {"collection": "read-only", "collector": "native-gcp", "requested_scopes": self.requested_scopes,
            "resolved_scopes": self.scopes, "inherited_scopes": getattr(self, "inherited_scopes", []),
            "auth_method": getattr(getattr(self.transport, "credentials", None), "method", selected_auth_method(self.auth)),
            "calls": getattr(self.transport, "calls", 0), "max_calls": self.max_calls, "max_pages": self.max_pages,
            "max_resources": self.max_items, "max_scopes": self.max_scopes, "concurrency": self.workers, "asset_read_time": self.read_time,
            "intentional_limits": {key: self.options[key] for key in ("max_calls", "max_pages", "max_resources", "max_scopes", "deadline_seconds")
                                   if self.options.get(key) is not None},
            "collection_mode": "intentionally_limited" if any(self.options.get(key) is not None for key in
                ("max_calls", "max_pages", "max_resources", "max_scopes", "deadline_seconds")) else "full",
            "omitted_inventories": sorted(SUPPORTED_TYPES - self.wanted), "supporting_inventories": sorted(self.needed - self.wanted),
            "source_requests": getattr(self.transport, "evidence", []), "scope_coverage": self.scope_errors,
            "hierarchy_discovery": hierarchy_discovery,
            "scope_type_omissions": {kind: sorted(types) for kind, types in sorted(getattr(self, "scope_type_omissions", {}).items())},
            "project_restrictions": sorted(self.allowed) if self.allowed is not None else None,
            "trusted_scope_ids": self.options.get("trusted_scope_ids", []),
            "trusted_domains": self.options.get("trusted_domains", []),
            "trusted_domains_explicit": "trusted_domains" in self.options,
            "trusted_users": self.options.get("trusted_users"),
            "trusted_groups": self.options.get("trusted_groups"),
            "trusted_service_accounts": self.options.get("trusted_service_accounts"),
            "service_usage_selection": ["*"],
            "service_usage_mode": "complete_list",
            "cloudbuild_location_selection": self.options.get("cloudbuild_locations"),
            "cloudbuild_location_mode": "selected" if "cloudbuild_locations" in self.options else "discovered",
            "limitations": ["CAI is eventually consistent; direct API reads are collected at their request time",
                "Audit absence never proves inactivity; disabled/denied Data Access logging limits activity evidence",
                "IAM policies and conditions are declared grants, not an effective-access decision",
                "Shared VPC references outside selected projects are not traversed"]}
        if {"firewall_policy", "firewall_policy_association"} <= self.wanted:
            projects = [scope for scope in self.scopes if scope.startswith("projects/")]
            evidence = []
            unaffected_projects = []
            project_ancestors = {}
            for project_scope in projects:
                ancestry = self.ancestry.get(project_scope)
                ancestry_request = self.ancestry_source_requests.get(project_scope)
                if (not isinstance(ancestry, list) or not ancestry or not ancestry_request or
                    not isinstance(ancestry[0], dict) or not isinstance(ancestry[0].get("resourceId"), dict) or
                    ancestry[0]["resourceId"].get("type") != "project" or
                    any(not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("resourceId"), dict) or
                        item["resourceId"].get("type") not in ("folder", "organization") or
                        not isinstance(item["resourceId"].get("id"), str) or
                        not item["resourceId"]["id"].isdigit() for item in ancestry[1:]) or
                    any(item["resourceId"]["type"] == "organization" for item in ancestry[1:-1])):
                    continue
                project_evidence = [{"path": f"projects/{project_scope.split('/', 1)[1]}:getAncestry",
                    "source_requests": [ancestry_request]}]
                ancestors = [f"{item['resourceId']['type']}s/{item['resourceId']['id']}"
                    for item in ancestry if item["resourceId"]["type"] in ("folder", "organization")]
                complete = True
                for policy_scope in [project_scope, *ancestors]:
                    kind = "firewall_policy" if policy_scope == project_scope else "firewall_policy_association"
                    inventory = self.collections.get((kind, policy_scope))
                    if (not inventory or inventory["status"] not in ("collected", "empty") or
                        not inventory.get("source_requests")):
                        complete = False
                        break
                    if kind == "firewall_policy_association" and inventory["items"]:
                        complete = False
                        break
                    if kind == "firewall_policy" and any(
                        item.get("_provenance", {}).get("representation") != "full" or
                        not isinstance(item.get("associations", []), list) or item.get("associations")
                        for item in inventory["items"]):
                        complete = False
                        break
                    project_evidence.append({"path": f"collections.{kind}[{policy_scope}]",
                        "source_requests": inventory["source_requests"]})
                networks = self.collections.get(("network", project_scope))
                if networks and any(item.get("firewallPolicy") not in (None, "") for item in networks["items"]):
                    complete = False
                if complete:
                    unaffected_projects.append(project_scope)
                    project_ancestors[project_scope] = ancestors
                    evidence.extend(project_evidence)
            if unaffected_projects:
                metadata["network_context"] = {"gcp": {"firewall_hierarchy": {
                    "status": "collected", "complete": True, "policies": [],
                    "unaffected_projects": unaffected_projects, "project_ancestors": project_ancestors,
                    "source_evidence": evidence}}}
        from .gcp_appengine_versions import approved_version_maxima
        appengine_policy = approved_version_maxima(self.options, self.scopes)
        if appengine_policy is not None:
            metadata["appengine_version_policy"] = appengine_policy
        from .gcp_compliance_wave import policy_metadata
        metadata.update(policy_metadata(self.options, self.scopes))
        if self.sw52_native_mode:
            metadata["sw52_native"] = self.sw52_native
        if self.psc_owner_policy is not None:
            from peaso.gcp_psc_policy import OPTION as PSC_OPTION, normalize as normalize_psc_policy
            metadata[PSC_OPTION] = normalize_psc_policy(self.psc_owner_policy, self.scopes)
        if self.audit_owner_policy is not None:
            from peaso.gcp_data_access_policy import OPTION, normalize_owner_policy
            metadata[OPTION] = normalize_owner_policy(self.audit_owner_policy, self.scopes)
        # Preserve exactly the user's selection; resolved scopes and ancestry are
        # separately explicit and every collection is individually scoped.
        snapshot_scopes = (self.scopes or ["*"]) if self.auto_scopes else self.requested_scopes
        snapshot = make_snapshot("gcp", snapshot_scopes, envelopes, metadata=sanitize(metadata))
        self.progress("error" if self.auth_error else "completed", complete=True)
        return snapshot

def canonical_service(row, scope):
    """Validate one Service Usage row without discarding its raw identity."""
    if not isinstance(row, dict) or not isinstance(scope, str):
        raise ValueError("malformed or foreign Service Usage fact")
    get(row, "name", str)
    coverage = row.get("_coverage", {})
    for field, kind in (("parent", str), ("config", dict), ("rawNativeName", str)):
        if field in row or field in coverage:
            get(row, field, kind)
    name = row.get("name")
    prefix = scope + "/services/"
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.startswith(prefix):
        raise ValueError("malformed or foreign Service Usage fact")
    service = canonical_target(name[len(prefix):])

    if "config" in row:
        config = row["config"]
        if not isinstance(config, dict):
            raise ValueError("malformed or foreign Service Usage fact")
        if "name" in config or "name" in config.get("_coverage", {}):
            get(config, "name", str)
        if "name" in config and canonical_target(config["name"]) != service:
            raise ValueError("Service Usage config name contradicts resource name")

    raw = row.get("rawNativeName")
    parent = row.get("parent")
    provenance = row.get("_provenance")
    alias = provenance.get("derived_project_alias") if isinstance(provenance, dict) else None
    if isinstance(provenance, dict) and ("derived_project_alias" in provenance or
            "derived_project_alias" in provenance.get("_coverage", {})):
        alias = get(provenance, "derived_project_alias", dict)
        for field, kind in (("canonical_name", str), ("native_name", str), ("basis", str),
                            ("project_identity_source_requests", list)):
            get(alias, field, kind)
    if raw is not None or alias is not None:
        if (not isinstance(raw, str) or not isinstance(alias, dict) or
                alias.get("canonical_name") != name or alias.get("native_name") != raw or
                row.get("native_id") != raw or row.get("_resource_id") != raw or
                alias.get("basis") != "complete same-scope Cloud Resource Manager project identity" or
                not isinstance(alias.get("project_identity_source_requests"), list) or
                not alias["project_identity_source_requests"] or
                any(not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref for ref in alias["project_identity_source_requests"])):
            raise ValueError("unproved Service Usage project alias")
        native_parent, separator, native_service = raw.partition("/services/")
        if (not separator or not re.fullmatch(r"projects/[0-9]+", native_parent) or
                canonical_target(native_service) != service or
                (parent is not None and parent != native_parent)):
            raise ValueError("Service Usage native identity contradicts alias")
    elif parent is not None and parent != scope:
        raise ValueError("foreign Service Usage parent")
    return service

def principal_trust_lists(metadata):
    """Operator principal trust lists by member prefix, or None when none was configured.

    The collector records an unset list as null and trusted_domains as [] with
    trusted_domains_explicit=false, so "no configuration" is distinguishable
    from an explicitly empty list. Once any list is configured, unset ones are empty."""
    from collections.abc import Mapping
    if not isinstance(metadata, Mapping):
        raise Unavailable("malformed principal trust policy")
    configured = any(metadata.get(field) is not None for prefix, field in PRINCIPAL_TRUST_FIELDS if field != "trusted_domains")
    configured = configured or metadata.get("trusted_domains_explicit") is True or (
        "trusted_domains_explicit" not in metadata and metadata.get("trusted_domains") is not None)
    if not configured:
        return None
    approved = {}
    for prefix, field in PRINCIPAL_TRUST_FIELDS:
        values = metadata.get(field)
        values = [] if values is None else values
        if not isinstance(values, (list, tuple)) or any(not isinstance(value, str) for value in values):
            raise Unavailable("malformed principal trust policy")
        approved[prefix] = set(values)
    return approved

        raise Unavailable("scope root IAM policy absent or ambiguous")

def network_identity(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError('VPC reference must be a string')
    parsed = urlsplit(value)
    if (parsed.scheme != 'https' or parsed.hostname not in ('www.googleapis.com', 'compute.googleapis.com') or
            parsed.port not in (None, 443) or parsed.username or parsed.query or parsed.fragment):
        raise ValueError('VPC reference must be a native Compute network URL')
    match = re.fullmatch(r'/compute/v1/(projects/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/global/networks/([a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62})', parsed.path)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError('VPC identity is malformed')
    return match[1] + '/global/networks/' + match[2]

def rows(index, kind, scope):
    envelopes = index.get('collections', {}).get(kind, [])
    if len(envelopes) != 1:
        raise Unavailable('Complete project inventory unavailable: ' + kind)
    env = envelopes[0]
    if (env.get('scope') != scope or env.get('type') != kind or env.get('status') not in ('collected', 'empty') or
            env.get('coverage_status', env.get('status')) not in ('collected', 'empty')):
        raise Unavailable('Foreign or incomplete project inventory: ' + kind)
    native = get(env, 'items', list)
    observed = complete_items(index, kind)
    encode = lambda value: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))
    if (len(native) != len(observed) or (env['status'] == 'empty') != (not native) or
            Counter(map(encode, native)) != Counter(map(encode, observed))):
        raise Unavailable('Inventory projection or cardinality differs: ' + kind)
    wrappers = index.get(kind, [])
    if len(wrappers) != len(native) or any(row.get('scope') != scope or row.get('type') != kind or
                                         row.get('provider', 'gcp') != 'gcp' for row in wrappers):
        raise Unavailable('Foreign resource projection: ' + kind)
    return observed

def full_representation(item):
    """True only when the collector marked the item as the API's complete
    resource representation (no field mask or partial projection)."""
    guard(item)
    provenance = item.get("_provenance")
    return isinstance(provenance, dict) and provenance.get("representation") == "full"

def gcp_effective_boolean_constraint(index, constraint):
    """Resolve an effective boolean policy only for this exact project/constraint.

    Imported snapshots retain the provider's policy name independently of the
    collection wrapper. A numeric project alias needs the producer's CRM read
    binding and its matching request trace; the policy payload is not an alias
    authority.
    """
    import re
    from .facts import Unavailable, complete_items
    envelopes = index.get("collections", {}).get("org_policy_effective", [])
    if not isinstance(envelopes, list) or len(envelopes) != 1 or not isinstance(envelopes[0], dict):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy scope ambiguous")
    scope = envelopes[0].get("scope")
    if not isinstance(scope, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"projects/[^/:%]+", scope):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy project scope unavailable")
    context = index.get("context")
    if (not isinstance(context, dict) or context.get("scope") != scope
            or context.get("provider") != "gcp"):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy context scope mismatch")
    policies = [p for p in complete_items(index, "org_policy_effective") if get(p, "constraint", str) == constraint]
    if len(policies) != 1:
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy missing or ambiguous: " + constraint)
    policy = policies[0]
    suffix = "/policies/" + constraint
    name = get(policy, "name", str)
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.endswith(suffix):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy name/constraint mismatch")
    parent = name[:-len(suffix)]
    provenance = optional(policy, "_provenance", {}, dict)
    if not isinstance(provenance, dict) or (optional(provenance, "scope", None, str) not in (None, scope)):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy provenance scope mismatch")
    alias = optional(policy, "project_alias", None, dict)
    if parent == scope:
        if alias is not None:
            raise Unavailable("unexpected effective org policy alias")
    else:
        if (not re.fullmatch(r"projects/[1-9][0-9]*", parent)
                or not isinstance(alias, dict)
                or get(alias, "requested_scope", str) != scope
                or get(alias, "project_id", str) != scope.split("/", 1)[1]
                or get(alias, "canonical_name", str) != parent
                or get(alias, "source_operation", str) != "projects.get"
                or not isinstance(get(alias, "source_request", str), str)
                or not get(alias, "source_request", str)):
            raise Unavailable("effective org policy project alias unresolved")
        requests = optional(get(context, "metadata", dict), "source_requests", [], list)
        if not isinstance(requests, list):
            raise Unavailable("effective org policy alias request trace missing")
        expected_url = "https://cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/v3/" + scope
        matches = [entry for entry in requests if isinstance(entry, dict)
                   and get(entry, "id", str) == get(alias, "source_request", str)]
        if (len(matches) != 1 or get(matches[0], "url", str) != expected_url
                or get(matches[0], "method", str) != "GET"
                or get(matches[0], "scope", str) != scope
                or get(matches[0], "status", str) != "collected"):
            raise Unavailable("effective org policy alias request unverified")
    # An evaluated Policy with no spec/rules means nothing is set anywhere in
    # the hierarchy: a boolean constraint is then not enforced.
    spec = optional(policy, "spec", {}, dict)
    rules = list_of_objects(optional(spec, "rules", [], list))
    if any(set(rule) - {"enforce", "_coverage"} or set(optional(rule, "_coverage", {}, dict)) - {"enforce"} for rule in rules):
        raise Unavailable("conditional or non-boolean effective org policy rule: " + constraint)
    values = {get(rule, "enforce", bool) for rule in rules}
    if len(values) > 1:
        raise Unavailable("contradictory effective org policy rules: " + constraint)
    return values == {True}, name

def gcp_oslogin_unset(index):
    """enable-oslogin not set at the instance or project: SSH falls back to
    metadata-managed keys ("By default, Compute Engine uses custom project and/or
    instance metadata to configure SSH keys") unless compute.requireOsLogin is
    enforced. Returns (enabled, effective policy name); Unavailable when the
    effective policy was not collected."""
    enforced, name = gcp_effective_boolean_constraint(index, "compute.requireOsLogin")
    return enforced, name

review_limitations: Reachable helper discovery follows static Python names, closures and ID-keyed dispatch dictionaries; dynamic imports and imported-module attribute calls require manual follow-up.
